cases.narrative:
On 7/7/1992, her body was found around 6:15 am in a rural area of Surry County, just off the northbound side of the Interstate-77 highway.

Retired SBI agent William “John” Foster was interviewed and said, "...she was working the rest area in Cleveland County, and she went into a truck. She was there with her girlfriend, and they both were working the truck stop, I mean the rest area. Then the truck leaves, and then the girlfriend never found her again.

So what happened was, the next day, the truck obviously came from Cleveland County on 85 and was going north on 77, pulled over at the Elkin exit and threw her out. 

How she was found, she had a dress that was up to her chest and was nude from there down and her leg caught on the guardrail. So her leg was sticking up and another truck driver pulled over, happened to see her, called the sheriff’s department."
